welcome: It’s good to have you here.
overview: A little more clarity. A lot more peace of mind.
shortcutTitle: What would you like to do today?
shortcutSubtitle: Your next step, without the extra steps.
reportHint: We’ll take it step by step
activityNote: Changing language does not convert currency.
productHint: Room for your plans, big and small.
noProducts: You have no products available yet.
requestHint: Check progress and pick up the conversation whenever you need.
createFirst: You can create one from any transaction or service.
handoffExplain: Your request will be marked for support, keeping the context you shared.
detailPlaceholder: Add details to help us understand your question…
characters: 10–1,000 characters. Do not include passwords or sensitive data.
confirmCheck: I reviewed the details and want to submit this request.
requestExplain: We’ll save your request so you can track it. Creating a case does not imply a refund.
saved: Request saved. You can track its progress.
duplicate: This transaction already has a request. We opened its progress.
guided: Guidance, one step at a time.
assistantIntro: Sometimes it just takes a conversation. What can I help you with today?
talkHuman: I’d like to talk to a person
voiceUnavailable: Read aloud is not available in this browser.
voiceError: Unable to play audio. The answer is available as text.
helpBody: Find clear answers or continue with your assistant.
answer1: View your products and transactions, submit requests and track their progress. Your preferences are saved in your account.
help2: How do I check the status of a request?
answer2: Open My requests to see the reference, status and history of each case. You can also ask for support there.
help3: How do I look after my information?
answer3: Use your personal session and sign out when you finish, especially on a shared device. Never include your password in an enquiry.
adminNote: Manage requests, review their status and view recorded activity.
noRefund: This request does not confirm fraud or issue a refund.
pendingNote: This payment is still pending. You can request a review before trying again.
declinedNote: This payment was declined. Review the details or ask for help with the next step.
noHuman: Your request has been recorded for support. You can track its status here.
loginTitle: Your space. Your peace of mind.
loginSubtitle: Sign in and find your next step.
loginNote: Sign in with your email and password.
loginFeature: It all starts with feeling supported.
loginDescription: Your accounts, your questions and a clear next step. Banking that feels a little closer.
sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
serviceIntro: Find what you need, all in one place.
serviceNote: Tell us what you need. You can review the details before confirming your request.
cardsHint: Find your card and review a charge.
transfersHint: Review transactions and ask about a transfer.
paymentsHint: Check a payment status or report a problem.
loansHint: Ask about personal loans and mortgages.
investmentsHint: Prepare your questions about investment products.
insuranceHint: Ask for information about available insurance.
cashHint: Ask about a recorded withdrawal or deposit.
confirmationError: Review the details and select the confirmation.
error.invalid_login: The email or password is incorrect.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes before trying again.
error.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
error.forbidden: Your account cannot perform this action.
error.not_found: This record was not found in your account.
error.csrf: We could not validate the session. Reload the page.
error.generic: We couldn’t complete the action. Please try again.
error.network: We could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_transition: The status changed. Refresh the request.
serviceDetail: Review your transactions or tell us what you need. You can follow your enquiry in My requests.
footerNote: Nexqori · With you at every step.
loginBenefitBody: View your accounts and track your requests from your own space.
error.chat_busy: A query is in progress. Wait before sending again.
error.chat_expired: The conversation ended. Send your query to start another.
error.chat_conflict: We could not validate the message. Send it again.
error.chat_limit: You reached the query limit for this session. Sign in again.
humanTemporary: This conversation is temporary: it is removed on sign-out, server restart or after two hours.
humanConsent: The messages in this conversation and its purpose will be shared with Nexqori operators. System credentials will not be shared.
error.chat_assigned: Another operator is already handling this conversation.
